name: Nightmare Sisay
description: A half-flesh, half-bone nightmare version of Sisay that mocks Shanna and is destroyed.

timeline.summary: Shanna confronts a nightmare Sisay who mocks her legacy and shows her visions of her friends dying; Shanna destroys it.
timeline.quote: There was no artistry to Shanna's assault, only brutality.
